findings.reason: The cited README pipeline spans lines 41–84, with its heading one line before the nominal range, and both the required check script and a repository-wide search confirm that no MME, MMBench, MM-Vet, or MOSSBench preparation or scoring code is present.
findings.changed: verdict restored from reject to keep because the one-line citation offset does not invalidate the substantive evidence

findings.reason: The HF activation and steering path hardcodes LlavaForConditionalGeneration and the public model map exposes only LLaVA checkpoints, but an unregistered generation-only QwenVL vLLM class exists, so the core reproducibility concern holds while the claim that Qwen-VL is wholly unimplemented is overstated.
